info.name: mindHR API
info.description: Generated from the Spring controllers (postman/generate_postman.py). 1) Run Auth > POST /api/auth/login. 2) Copy the token from the response and paste it into the collection variable `token`. Every other request sends it as a Bearer token. Platform staff must pass `organizationId` on org-owned resources; org users are scoped automatically.
